text: The low beam headlamp is rated at 12.12 W. The manual gives 14.22 W for the high beam and low beam together. Watch out: Using bulbs or electrical gadgets with a rating other than the specified one can overload the electrical system, cause erratic behavior or lead to premature failure. The manual does not give a wattage for the high beam on its own.
